title: What do you do in free time?

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Samal, classes are over! What do you usually do in your free time?

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Photography, of course! I always take my camera when I leave class.

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Every day? Don't you ever just relax and do nothing?

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Photography IS my way of relaxing! What about you — what do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: I play basketball three times a week — Monday, Wednesday, Friday after class.

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Basketball! Where do you play — on the WKU court?

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Yes, always. I also play video games in the evenings when I finish homework.

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Video games every evening? Which games do you play?

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Strategy games mostly — I love planning and thinking ahead. It's like chess!

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Interesting! Do you do anything outdoors on weekends? Besides basketball?

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Yes! I go hiking on Sundays. There are beautiful trails near Uralsk.

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Wait — I go hiking too! I take my camera on the trails. Incredible photos!

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Really? We should go together next Sunday! The light on the hills is amazing.

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Yes! I can photograph while you hike. We make a perfect team!

dialogue.speaker: Timur
dialogue.text: Deal! And in the evenings I'll teach you my favourite strategy game.

dialogue.speaker: Samal
dialogue.text: Ha! And I'll teach you how to take a great photo. Fair trade!
